text:
kevin lee: Hi team! First-week snag. I restored my personal Time Machine backup onto the corp MBP (M1) and after the restore Kandji shows 'Profile mismatch' and the mac prompts to complete Device Enrollment but the button is gray. Also FileVault prompt asks for a local admin password I never set. I need VPN cert to join standup. Who do I flag?

ana - IT: Welcome Kevin! Restoring a personal TM can change some device identifiers and confuse ABM/Kandji. Dont try to force enroll. Can you run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` and paste the output? Also, what's the serial?

kevin lee: Serial is C02M1KL98765. `profiles renew` output: "No configuration profiles found". Kandji shows device in the dashboard but with status: "Profile mismatch - pending re-enrollment".

mike - infra: That output means the local enrollment profile was overwritten by your restore. We can push a remote enrollment command from Kandji but we need the device to accept it. @ana - IT do we have a short-lived temp admin option for re-attaching the MDM?

ana - IT: Yep. Before we do that, try rebooting to recovery and running the bootstrap enroll (instructions: hold Option at boot -> Recovery -> Terminal -> run `startosinstall --reinstall --agreetolicense` to reinstall macOS without wiping, this usually preserves user data but restores system files and can let MDM reapply). If youre not comfortable, we can provision temp admin for 1 hour. Which do you prefer?

kevin lee: Prefer not to reinstall during week 1. Temp admin would be easier. Also need VPN cert for the standup in 40 minutes.

ana - IT: Granting 60-minute sudo via TempAccess. DMing creds. Also opening ticket INC-2026-21845 to track.

vpn-admin: For VPN certs, we issue a machine-bound cert after the device is enrolled and appears in Okta device list. We can issue a provisional user cert if youre on the corp network or on VPN via Duo Mobile push. Do you have Duo setup?

kevin lee: I haven't completed Duo SSO yet because the Okta prompt didn't show. I have my phone ready.

security-bot: Security note: Temp admin sessions are audited and expire automatically. Do not install any credential managers or re-use SSH keys from personal machines on the corp device.

ana - IT: DM sent — username temp-kevin, exp 60m. Kevin, once you SSH in, run `profiles renew -type enrollment` then open Kandji and accept the pending command. After that FileVault should kick off and escrow the key.

kevin lee: Logged in with temp-kevin, ran `profiles renew` and Kandji accepted re-enroll. FileVault prompt now shows "Escrow succeeded". VPN still not showing cert though.

vpn-admin: Noted. I pushed a provisional cert to your Okta account; you should see the cert in Keychain labeled "Redwood VPN - provisional". If you don't, log out and back in or restart the VPN client.

kevin lee: I see the cert now and connected to VPN. Standup safe. Thanks so much!

ana - IT: Great — closing INC-2026-21845 after 24h if no regressions. One ask: in future, instead of restoring a personal TM to a corp image, create a fresh user and migrate files with Migration Assistant. That avoids profile mismatches.

kevin lee: Will do. Appreciate the fast help — official intro in #general coming later :)
